description: Utilities for converting between different data formats and types. Supports JSON, URL encoding, and URL parsing and serialization.

instructions.name: Parse JSON
Convert to JSON

instructions.description:
This function performs deserialization of URI encoding string.

Example 1:
It takes string like
```
name=Olaf&age=25&city=Hamburg
```
converts to
```
{
    name: "Olaf",
    age: "25",
    city: "Hamburg"
}
```

Example 2:
It takes string like
```
data=%20%3C%3E%3F%23%5B%5D%40%21%24%26%27%28%29%2A%2B%2C%3B%3D%3A%40%25
```
converts to storage value
```
{
    data: " <>?#[]@!$&'()*+,;=:@%"
}
```
Note: That leading space is because 20 is a hex representation of a space character.

See more on: [RFC3986 Section 2.1 Percent-Encoding](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3986#section-2.1)
instructions.name: Parse URL encoded

instructions.description:
Converts storage value to URL encoding

Example 1:
It takes storage value like
```
{
    name: "Olaf",
    age: "25",
    city: "Hamburg"
}
```
converts to URI-encoded string
```
name=Olaf&age=25&city=Hamburg
```

Example 2:
It takes storage value like
```
{
    data: " <>?#[]@!$&'()*+,;=:@%"
}
```
converts to URI-encoded string
```
data=%20%3C%3E%3F%23%5B%5D%40%21%24%26%27%28%29%2A%2B%2C%3B%3D%3A%40%25
```

instructions.description:
This function performs deserialization of URL string.

Example 1:
It takes string like
```furo
[
  {
    "id": "SzLbqsdO7BzVrS0K6rot3",
    "type": "call",
    "callee": "local/QkXeMcyG-l0LqQCF9zwCx",
    "parameters": [
      {
        "type": "tel",
        "name": "url",
        "expression": "\"https://api.turbofuro.com/test?param_one=hello&param_two=world#fragment\"",
        "valueDescription": "string"
      }
    ],
    "storeAs": "result"
  }
]
```
converts to a URL object storage value
```
{
  fragment: "fragment",
  host: "api.turbofuro.com",
  origin: "https://api.turbofuro.com",
  password: null,
  path: "/test",
  port: null,
  query: "param_one=hello&param_two=world",
  scheme: "https",
  username: ""
}
```

Example 2:
It takes string like
```furo
[
  {
    "id": "6rqH2MwaLarzBU0qBiaGc",
    "type": "call",
    "callee": "local/QkXeMcyG-l0LqQCF9zwCx",
    "parameters": [
      {
        "type": "tel",
        "name": "url",
        "expression": "\"postgres://username:password@localhost:5432/database\"",
        "valueDescription": "string"
      }
    ],
    "storeAs": "result"
  }
]
```
converts to a URL object storage value
```
{
  fragment: null,
  host: "localhost",
  origin: "null",
  password: "password",
  path: "/database",
  port: 5432,
  query: null,
  scheme: "postgres",
  username: "username"
}
```
Note: That leading space is because 20 is a hex representation of a space character.

See more on: [RFC3986 Section 2.1 Percent-Encoding](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3986#section-2.1)
instructions.name: Parse URL

instructions.description:
Converts storage value to URL

Example 1:
It takes storage value like
```furo
[
  {
    "id": "Dk_sP7nmZw7X2gdo7WggF",
    "type": "call",
    "callee": "local/cMpMs1Qkl6snZM26mpDoe",
    "parameters": [
      {
        "type": "tel",
        "name": "host",
        "expression": "\"localhost\"",
        "valueDescription": "string"
      },
      {
        "type": "tel",
        "name": "scheme",
        "expression": "\"postgres\"",
        "valueDescription": "string"
      },
      {
        "type": "tel",
        "name": "port",
        "expression": "5432",
        "valueDescription": "number | string"
      },
      {
        "type": "tel",
        "name": "path",
        "expression": "\"/database\"",
        "valueDescription": "string"
      },
      {
        "type": "tel",
        "name": "username",
        "expression": "\"username\"",
        "valueDescription": "string"
      },
      {
        "type": "tel",
        "name": "password",
        "expression": "\"password\"",
        "valueDescription": "string"
      }
    ],
    "storeAs": "url"
  }
]
```
converts to URL string
```
postgres://username:password@localhost:5432/database
```

Example 2:
It takes storage value like
```furo
[
  {
    "id": "QsfTiB6EuMmWqj89rafH2",
    "type": "call",
    "callee": "local/cMpMs1Qkl6snZM26mpDoe",
    "storeAs": "url",
    "parameters": [
      {
        "type": "tel",
        "name": "host",
        "expression": "\"api.turbofuro.com\"",
        "valueDescription": "string"
      },
      {
        "type": "tel",
        "name": "scheme",
        "expression": "\"https\"",
        "valueDescription": "string"
      },
      {
        "type": "tel",
        "name": "path",
        "expression": "\"/test\"",
        "valueDescription": "string"
      },
      {
        "type": "tel",
        "name": "query",
        "expression": "\"param_one=hello&param_two=world\"",
        "valueDescription": "string"
      },
      {
        "type": "tel",
        "name": "fragment",
        "expression": "\"fragment\"",
        "valueDescription": "string"
      }
    ]
  }
]
```
converts to URL string
```
https://api.turbofuro.com/test?param_one=hello&param_two=world#fragment
```
